<script>
/* FIERRO: checkout coupon. The cart page's coupon script also listens to this button,
   reads the cart's (missing) coupon box and sends an empty code ("Please enter a coupon code").
   Stop that here so WooCommerce's own checkout coupon handler applies the code. */
window.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.soharon-checkout-coupon .soharon-coupon-apply');
  if (btn) { e.stopPropagation(); }
}, true);
</script>
<style>
/* FIERRO: give the card form the full width of the payment box (label on top, form below) */
body.woocommerce-checkout .woocommerce-checkout-payment ul.payment_methods li.payment_method_stripe { display: block !important; padding: 14px 16px !important; }
body.woocommerce-checkout .woocommerce-checkout-payment li.payment_method_stripe > label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px !important; }
body.woocommerce-checkout .woocommerce-checkout-payment li.payment_method_stripe .payment_box { width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; }
body.woocommerce-checkout #payment .wc-stripe-upe-element { min-height: 40px; }
body.woocommerce-checkout #payment fieldset { border: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
/* coupon apply button had no visible label */
.soharon-checkout-coupon .soharon-coupon-apply { color: #fff !important; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* FIERRO 2026-10: desktop - Your Order box starts level with the first billing field */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
  .soharon-checkout form.checkout { grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr !important; align-items: start; }
  .soharon-checkout #order_review_heading { align-self: start; }
  .soharon-checkout #order_review { margin-top: -70px !important; align-self: start; } /* cancels the grid's 70px row gap so the box starts level with the first field */
}
/* "(Price inclusive of all taxes)" under the total */
.fierro-incl-tax { text-align: center; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 14px; color: #222222; margin: 12px 0 0 !important; }
@media (max-width: 767px) { .fierro-incl-tax { font-size: 12px; } }
</style><script>
/* FIERRO 2026-10: "Shipment" -> "Shipping" and the inclusive-price note under the order total.
   WooCommerce re-renders the order review after every change, so re-apply each time. */
(function(){
  function apply(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.woocommerce-checkout-review-order-table tr.woocommerce-shipping-totals th').forEach(function(th){
      if (th.textContent.trim() === 'Shipment') th.textContent = 'Shipping';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.woocommerce-checkout-review-order-table td[data-title="Shipment"]').forEach(function(td){ td.setAttribute('data-title','Shipping'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('table.woocommerce-checkout-review-order-table').forEach(function(t){
      var n = t.nextElementSibling;
      if (!n || !n.classList.contains('fierro-incl-tax')) {
        var p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'fierro-incl-tax'; p.textContent = '(Price inclusive of all taxes)';
        t.parentNode.insertBefore(p, t.nextSibling);
      }
    });
  }
  function start(){
    apply();
    if (window.jQuery) jQuery(document.body).on('updated_checkout', apply);
    var r = document.querySelector('#order_review') || document.body;
    new MutationObserver(apply).observe(r, {childList:true, subtree:true});
  }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') start(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
})();
</script>
